Nidd I 96, 19 (tam eva suddhadassiṃ visuddhadassiṃ parisuddhadassiṃ vodātadassiṃ ~-dassiṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se pariyodānadassiṃ, prob. wr ); — 2. accomplished, skilled; expert; — ~-sippa, mfn. , skilled, expert in one’s craft; Vin I 249, 16 (dve dārakā … dakkhā ~-sippā sake ācariyake nahāpitakamme; cf Sp 1103, 14 : niddosasippā); III 41, 28 (ahaṃ kho pana susikkhito anavayo sake ācariyake kumbhakārakamme ~-sippo; cf Sp 287, 23 : ~-sippo ti parisuddhasippo, anavayatte pi sati aññehi asadisasippo ti vuttaṃ hoti); Ja III 281, 19 (bodhisatto … kammārakule nibbattitvā vayappatto ~-sippo ahosi); Vism 136, 23 ; Vv-a 138, 14 ; — apariyodāta, mfn. , unclean; not clear or bright; S V 392, 25 (cattār’ imāni bhikkhave devānaṃ devapadāni avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya); A III 212, 14 (apariyodātassa cittassa pariyodapanāya); Vism 168, 8 (divā vijjamānā pi candalekhā aparisuddhā hoti apariyodātā); — caus. pr. 3 sg. pariyodapeti , pariyodāpeti [ BHS paryavadāpayati], cleanses, purifies; makes clear or bright; D III 191, 21 (assutaṃ sāventi sutaṃ ~enti saggassa maggaṃ ācikkhanti; Sv 957, 32 foll.: yaṃ tesaṃ pakatiyā sutaṃ atthi tassa atthaṃ kathetvā kaṅkhaṃ vinodenti tathattāya vā paṭipajjāpenti); M I 25, 22 (seyyathā pi āvuso kaṃsapātī … rajena ca malena ca pariyonaddhā tam enaṃ sāmikā na c’ eva paribhuñjeyyuṃ na ca ~eyyuṃ); II 234, 12 (te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā tattha ñāṇabhāgamattam eva ~enti; Ps IV 25, 9 foll.: mayaṃ idaṃ jānāma mayaṃ idaṃ jānāmā ti evaṃ tattha ñāṇakoṭṭhāsaṃ otārenti yeva); S V 24, 25* (~eyya attānaṃ cittaklesehi paṇḍito; Spk III 132, 23 : parisuddhaṃ kareyya) = Dhp 88; A III 248, 4 (pañc’ ime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā dhammasavane … assutaṃ suṇāti sutaṃ ~eti kaṅkhaṃ vihanati …); Nett 44, 28 foll. (yaṃ paṭivedhena ~eti idaṃ dukkhaṃ yato ~eti ayaṃ samudayo yena ~eti ayaṃ maggo, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pariyodāpeti); Cp-a 288, 19 (mahāpuriso attano upanissayasampattiṃ samma-d-eva ~eti); — part.pr. pariyodapenta, mf (~entī) n. , Thī-a 222, 27 (indriyāni ~entī); — inf. pariyodā̆petuṃ, Peṭ 203, 10 (pariyodāpetuṃ); Mp III 330, 5 (~etuṃ); — absol. pariyodāpetvā, Tikap-a 269, 20 (datvā ti cetanaṃ pariyodāpetvā visuddhaṃ katvā); — pp pariyodapita, pariyodāpita, mfn. , cleansed, purified; made bright; Nett 44, 21 (citte ~ite pañcakkhandhā ~itā bhavanti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pariyodāpite … pariyodāpitā); 44, 30 (yaṃ ~itaṃ ayaṃ nirodho, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pariyodāpitaṃ); Vism 149, 23 (pariyodāpitattā) = Nidd-a I 134, 12 ; Paṭis-a 475, 11 (pariyodāpitaṃ visodhitaṃ); — fpp pariyodapetabba, mfn. , Sv 479, 9 (arahattaphalena cittaṃ ~etabban ti, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se pariyodāpetabban ti).
